headline: Full clear with a record Four Horsemen, one Sapphiron wipe from Life Drains left running
overview: 15 of 15 bosses in 2h22m, about 16 minutes slower than the guild's usual Naxx night. A good part of that is the Sapphiron wipe (4:05 plus the run back) and a slow Sapphiron kill.

Fourteen bosses went down first try. The Four Horsemen kill (3:54) is the fastest in the logs, and Thaddius, Faerlina and Grobbulus were all well above the guild's usual standard on their key mechanics.

wipes.title: Sapphiron, pull 1 (wiped at 40%)
wipes.whatHappened: 21 of the 79 Life Drains were never removed and ran their full course, draining raiders and healing Sapphiron. People started dying at 0:40, 10 were dead by 1:45 (three healers and a tank among them), and once tanks went down the rest followed: 29 deaths in 4:05.
wipes.likelyCause: Life Drain not being decursed. On the kill pull, with the same 79 Life Drains, every single one was removed. Everything else on the wipe (Frost Aura deaths, Blizzard, the Cleave deaths when a tank died) is what happens once healers are losing that race.
evidence: Life Drain healed Sapphiron for about 297k on the wipe (roughly a tenth of his health) vs 38k on the kill
Life Drain: 79 applied, 21 never removed on the wipe vs 0 never removed on the kill
Life Drain dealt 165k to the raid on the wipe vs 59k on the kill, with 7 deaths directly to it
8 of 11 healers and 4 of 5 tanks died on the wipe
wipes.avoid: Decurse assignments by area that cover the whole raid from the first Life Drain (it lands on about 10 people every 24 seconds), with a backup decurser for each group. The kill pull shows the raid can do it: zero missed.

wentWell.text: Four Horsemen in 3:54, the fastest kill in the logs (previous best 4:12, guild median 5:06). Marks per raider were down to 12.6 from a usual 15.6.
Thaddius in 2:42 with only 6 wrong-side polarity hits. The guild usually takes around 30 hits there, and the median kill is 3:33.
Faerlina in 0:49 with 13 Rain of Fire hits, about a fifth of the usual 65 or so.
Grobbulus in 1:10 (median 1:27) with a median parse of 75, well up from the usual 57.
Kel'Thuzad down first try in 2:50 with only 2 Frost Blasts (usually about 28) and 5 mind controls (usually about 22).
27 raiders drank a shadow protection potion on Loatheb, more than three times the usual 8.

mechanics.text: Anub'Rekhan died in 0:48, a hair faster than ever, but Impale hit 29 raiders (34 hits, about two thirds more per raider than usual). Spreading out of each other's lines would cost nothing.

Four players died at the same moment (1:50) to a Mark from the Spirit of Mograine. Spirits keep marking after the Horseman dies, so this is a group standing too close to the dead corner rather than a missed rotation.

Frostbolt interrupts were about half the usual rate (20 vs roughly 39), and two raiders died to Frostbolt in the last 15 seconds. Two Guardian of Icecrown melee deaths at 2:15 and 2:30 suggest one Guardian got loose briefly.
Both Maexxna deaths, including the tank, came within 8 seconds after the first Web Spray at 0:40. The usual fix is HoTs and a shield on the tank before the Spray lands.

The kill pull was clean: all 79 Life Drains removed (median 2.7 seconds), no Frost Breath hits, 5 Blizzard hits. It was still slow (4:37 vs a usual 3:52) with a median parse of 36, the lowest of the night.
